items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Don made some helluva arrangements on that band.

ctx.x: Then on Sunday, we had one set where we could play anything we wanted, and then went hog wild for that one set. Near the end of the set, the guy, old McDonald I called him, he just caught me and give me this. That meant two waltzes and two tangos! That was the end of the Swing!
And we got air time down there, too; again, we got air time, you know. That was a good band, though. Don made some helluva arrangements on that band. Pshew! I just wish I had that book again.
And you know who was a helluva musician and a helluva clarinet player, he never really got any recognition in later years, was Prince Robinson.
